constraints.constraint_text: Treat pure CO2 arms (high and medium dose) as benchmark-comparable. Keep factorial extensions (CO2×O3, CO2×irrigation) separate to avoid construct drift.
No variance data available (SE/SD/CI not reported). Downstream meta-analysis must use variance imputation or unweighted models.
Treat this paper as the clean-support anchor: strong role convergence and only non-contradictory scope extensions beyond the benchmark rows.

Intervention/comparator: Elevated CO2 vs ambient CO2 in open-top chambers (OTC). Use OTC ambient control only; ambient air (AA) without chambers is a separate dataset and should not be used as control for CO2 comparisons.

Valid treatment arms: (1) Pure CO2 vs ambient (Exp 1, 2, 3), (2) CO2 dose-response (Exp 2: 347, 515, 667 ppm), (3) CO2×O3 factorial (Exp 1: 2 CO2 × 3 O3 levels), (4) CO2×irrigation factorial (Exp 3: 2 CO2 × 2 irrigation levels). O3-only experiments (4-6) are excluded.
Tissue: Only grain tissue is reported for Zn concentration. No other tissues or elements available.
Timepoints: Experiment-specific years: 1994 (Exp 1), 1995 (Exp 2), 1996 (Exp 3). Each experiment represents a distinct timepoint with independent measurements.
Units: Zn concentration measured in mg kg−1 (mg/kg) by ICP-AES.
Factorial structure: Present in Exp 1 (CO2×O3) and Exp 3 (CO2×irrigation). Exp 2 is dose-response, not factorial. Factorial arms introduce confounding from O3 or irrigation effects.

Scientifically valid numeric comparisons: (1) CO2 main effect vs OTC control, (2) CO2 dose-response across levels, (3) Factorial interaction effects. For benchmark comparability, restrict to pure CO2 comparisons without O3 or irrigation confounding.
Variance reporting: No numeric variance values published (no SE, SD, CI). Only p-values available in Table 2. This limits meta-analysis to variance-imputation or unweighted methods.
Sample sizes: Vary by experiment: n=3 for Exp 1, n=5 for Exp 2, n=6 for Exp 3. Sample size reflects number of chambers, not biological replicates within chambers.
Species and cultivar: Triticum aestivum L. (wheat), cultivar Dragon for all relevant CO2 experiments (1-3).
No numeric variance measures (SE, SD, CI) reported; only p-values available in Table 2.
Only grain Zn concentration reported; no other mineral elements measured or available.
Study includes CO2×O3 and CO2×irrigation factorial arms that confound pure CO2 signal; requires careful filtering for benchmark comparability.
